payload.title: Document correct Git Town version check (`git town --version`)
payload.body:
**Ticket:** `SKILLS-GIT-TOWN-STACK-001` · **Group:** Git Town stacked changes Cursor skill (`git-town-stacked-changes-skill`)

## Summary

Cursor agents intermittently treated Git Town as missing because they ran `git town version` to probe the CLI. The supported invocation for printing the version is `git town --version`. Update the `git-town-stacked-changes` skill so implementers and agents always use the correct probe and avoid false negatives.

## Scope

- **In scope:** Edit `.cursor/skills/git-town-stacked-changes/SKILL.md`—add a short **Prerequisites** or **Verify installation** note that explicitly says to check Git Town with `git town --version` (and states **not** to use `git town version`). Optionally mention this anywhere the skill implies validating the CLI.
- **Out of scope:** Changing Git Town itself; other skills unless they repeat the same wrong pattern (separate search/issue if found).

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] `SKILL.md` instructs verifying Git Town with **`git town --version`** as the canonical check.
- [ ] `SKILL.md` explicitly warns against **`git town version`** as a probe (subcommand / wrong flag pattern that led to intermittent failures).
- [ ] No regression to other skill content: stacked-change rules, Git Town command examples for `hack` / `append` / `sync`, and feature-flag guidance stay accurate.

## Dependencies

- **Depends on:** none
- **Blocks:** none

## Notes

- Root path: `mediapulse/.cursor/skills/git-town-stacked-changes/SKILL.md`.
